details: The highly anticipated U.S. CLARITY Act, a bill aimed at establishing regulatory clarity for crypto markets, is facing delays in the Senate. Competing legislative priorities, such as a Russia sanctions bill, and ongoing ethical disputes have stalled its progress, dampening market expectations for immediate regulatory dividends. The delay contributed to a collective plunge in cryptocurrencies, with Bitcoin falling below $65,000 and Ethereum also seeing significant drops.
title: CLARITY Act Faces Senate Delay, Crypto Markets React Bearishly

details: Bitcoin has shown a slight recovery to around $63,500 after experiencing a nearly 3% drop over the past 24 hours. This rebound comes as global equity markets display weakness, with Nasdaq futures hitting three-month lows. However, easing geopolitical tensions, particularly a pause in U.S.-Iran hostilities, have contributed to a "risk-on" sentiment that provided some uplift to crypto prices.
title: Bitcoin Recovers Slightly Amid Global Market Weakness and Geopolitical Reprieve

details: Ethereum-focused Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) attracted $103.9 million in inflows last week, more than tripling the $33.8 million seen by Bitcoin ETFs. This marks the third consecutive week of inflows for Ethereum funds, indicating a shift in institutional interest towards Ethereum, despite Bitcoin ETF inflows weakening towards the end of the week.
title: Ethereum ETFs Outperform Bitcoin Funds in Recent Inflows

details: Bitmine, a major Ethereum treasury company, acquired an additional 9,946 ETH last week, increasing its total holdings to 5.79 million ETH ($11.2 billion). Chairman Tom Lee pointed to Ethereum's outperformance against Bitcoin and a three-month high in the ETH/BTC ratio as indicators of strengthening crypto market sentiment and a positive outlook for Ethereum prices.
title: Bitmine Boosts Ethereum Holdings, Cites Bullish ETH/BTC Ratio

details: An SEC filing revealed that Strive acquired 79 Bitcoin between July 20 and July 24, 2026, at an average price of $65,723 per Bitcoin. This institutional purchase demonstrates ongoing confidence and accumulation of Bitcoin by investment firms.
title: Strive Purchases 79 Bitcoin, Signifying Continued Institutional Interest
